query: Which American cable news and talk radio host was the former GOP representative

pipeline_result.response: Charles Joseph Scarborough, also known as Joe Scarborough (April 9, 1963 - present), is the American cable news and talk radio host who served as a GOP Representative from the 1st district of Florida.
retrieved_context: Joe Scarborough: Charles Joseph Scarborough ( ; born April 9, 1963) is an American cable news and talk radio host.  He is currently the co-host of "Morning Joe" on MSNBC, and previously hosted "Scarborough Country" on the same channel.  Scarborough was previously a lawyer and a politician, and served in the United States House of Representatives from 1995 to 2001 as a Republican from the 1st district of Florida.

Morning Joe: Morning Joe is a weekday NBC News morning news and talk show, airing from 6:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the network's cable news channel MSNBC.  It features former GOP representative Joe Scarborough providing both enterprise reporting and discussion on the news of the day in a panel format with co-hosts Mika Brzezinski and Willie Geist.  It was created as the replacement for "Imus in the Morning," which was cancelled in April 2007 after simulcasting on MSNBC since 1996.
